violations.text: The hand-washing sinks in the kitchen was lacking handwashing signage. Inspector provided. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer and meat shredder) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC washed/sanitized during inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/26/2026
The glass window of the steam table was not in good repair (cracked glass). New Violation. Correct By: 10/26/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the bandsaw have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 10/26/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the basement and garage areas. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 12/31/2026
The hand-washing sinks throughout were lacking proper handwashing signage. New Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2026
Fresh ginger was observed with a gray fuzzy growth. PIC discarded ginger. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2026

Raw animal foods (eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (salami) in the deli display. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC relocated eggs. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer, meat shredder, bandsaw, and meat grinder) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC took units out of service to be washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2026

Cut melon was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. PIC put date on cut melons. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2026

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. New Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2026

The door to the outside, located in the back, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026

The presence of rodents and small flies are not controlled as evidenced by large rodent droppings (retail and basement areas), rat burrow (basement area), and live small flies (retail area). The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2026
Inspector observed dead rat in basement area. PIC informed to dispose of rat. New Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2026
Onions were observed stored on the floor in the kitchen. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. PIC relocated onions. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2026

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of dried beans. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. New Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2026

Foil is used in the construction of shelf liners in the small deli display unit and prep table shelf in the kitchen area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2026

The following was observed in poor repair: - large hot-hold unit (ambient 111F) - small hot-hold unit (did not heat) - steam table window (cracked glass) - meat shredder (cracked plastic guard) New Violation. Correct By: 10/26/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chloring sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2026

The basement and garage has an accumulation of soil residue, food debris, and/or droppings. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2026
The ceiling tiles in the retail area is in poor repair (previous water damager). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the basement and garage areas. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 12/31/2026
The fan covers in the walk-in cooler have an accumulation of soil residue. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2026
